inputs := [
    "(a + b) * [c - d]", "{{x = [1, 2, (3 + 4)]}}", "f(a[i] + g(b)}}", "(1 + 2)) * 3",
    "if (a < b) {{ c = d[0]; }}", "((a + b] * c", "[{{(x * y) - z}}",
]
openings := "([{{"
closings := ")]}}"
for text := inputs[]
    stack := ""
    failure := -1
    for: i < #text
        character := text[i]
        if openings.contains(character)
            stack += character
        else
            match closings.find(character)
                nat position
                    if #stack == 0 or stack[#stack - 1] != openings[position]
                        failure = int(i)
                        break
                    stack = stack[:<#stack - 1]
                none
                    continue
    if failure == -1 and #stack > 0
        failure = int(#text)
    result := if failure == -1 then "balanced" else "error at index {failure}"
    println("{text} -> {result}")
